Output indices for distinct basis vectors remain distinct for all powers, so (C^k)*C^k is diagonal with strictly decreasing weights d_n^(k)=∏_{j=0}^{k−1}K/[(log n+(j+1)t)(log n+jt+u)(log n+jt+v)]. Norm is d_1^(k)=(K/t³)^k/[k!(u/t)_k(v/t)_k], yielding Γ(u/t)Γ(v/t) k (K/t³)^k/(k!)³ and spectral radius zero; fixed-k singular values ∼K^k/(log n)^{3k}, compact but not any finite Schatten class by divergence of log-power sums. s1=|u−v|/t fixes the unordered ratio u/t,v/t; for this ratio, s2/s1 is a strictly increasing function of t>0, recovering log a/log b uniquely. Independently checked symbolic/numerical weights for four distinct integer pairs and k=1,2,3. The a=b commutator vanishes as boundary.
